args.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: Grave Accord production game sprite idle loop. Edit the supplied transparent reference canvas into ONE COMPLETE FOUR-FRAME IDLE SPRITE SHEET, two columns by two rows, reading left-to-right then down. Use the supplied dead lamplighter as the exact character identity and finish authority. Same 3/4 south-east facing in EVERY frame, identical gaunt skull face, blue-teal peaked cap, triangular torn dark teal coat with broad quiet gouache fabric surfaces, cream central shirt, brown boots and wraps. Physical LEFT hand (viewer right) holds exactly one caged brass lantern lowered beside the thigh; physical right hand near chest. Keep feet planted in identical positions and keep overall character height identical across all four frames. Delicate breathing and a tiny continuous lantern pendulum, small coat hem settling, seamless loop: 1 neutral, 2 gentle inhale, 3 tiny exhale/lantern outward by a few pixels, 4 return toward neutral. This is subtle idle breathing, never a walk, attack, extra gesture or pose turnaround. Reproduce the same outfit proportions, face, hand anatomy and lantern shape, keep the cap height and boots unchanged. Same readable dry black ink contour and matte opaque gouache as reference; sparse focal face/hand/prop detail, no grain noise. Draw all four frames at once on a genuinely transparent RGBA background, each whole figure fully contained in a separate equal square cell with broad clear gutters on every side, identical bottom-center foot location, no overlap or ground shadow. Fill the 2x2 sheet at useful asset resolution; frame images should be large. Preserve physical-left lantern ownership, coherent fingers holding handle, no limb swaps or mirrored bodies. No scenery, particles, glow haze, smoke, floor, backdrop, checkerboard paint, labels, typography, borders, watermarks, or added objects. Return the finished four-frame sheet only.
